newsitem.title: CANADA: Amoco Canada mulling sale of Canmar unit.
newsitem.headline: Amoco Canada mulling sale of Canmar unit.

text.p: Amoco Corp's Canadian subsidiary Amoco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd said on Thursday it is considering the sale of its Canadian Marine (Canmar) drilling services division.
"The services Canmar provides are outside Amoco Canada's core businesses," said Bob Erickson, chairman and president of Amoco Canada.
Canmar is based in Calgary and is a leading provider of Arctic offshore drilling and marine services contracting, operating a fleet of four drilling systems and six support vessels.
Amoco Canada said it had retained the services of Lazard Freres & Co. LLC of New York to explore the possible sale of Canmar and other strategic alternatives.
